name: Enterprise Identity
description: Service definitions for delegated user, workload, tenant, group, and purpose-of-use identity.

name: OIDC and SAML Identity
description: Projects verified OIDC or SAML claims into scoped agent identity without trusting prompt content.

name: HashiCorp Vault Credentials
description: Resolves short-lived secret references from Vault with audit and lease awareness.

name: AWS Secrets Manager
description: Resolves credential references with workload identity and regional controls.

name: Azure Key Vault
description: Resolves secrets through managed identity and auditable Key Vault operations.

name: GCP Secret Manager
description: Resolves versioned secrets through Google workload identity.

name: CyberArk Credentials
description: Retrieves governed privileged credentials and records checkout context.

name: OPA/Rego Policy
description: Evaluates tool actions through a centralized policy decision point with decision identifiers.

name: Cedar Policy
description: Evaluates principal, action, resource, and context through Cedar authorization policies.

name: Enterprise Scope and Approval Policy
description: Enforces Jira project and Confluence space allowlists and approval-gated writes.

name: Enterprise DLP
description: Blocks configured credentials, private keys, and regulated identifiers in outbound connector arguments.

name: Enterprise Model Gateway
description: Applies provider, model, region, budget, content-filter, cache, and fallback policy.

name: Local Redacted Audit
description: Writes owner-only redacted JSONL records from authoritative final tool outcomes.

name: OpenTelemetry and SIEM Audit
description: Exports correlated policy, approval, tool, and external transaction evidence to central systems.

name: Confluence
description: Searches permission-scoped Confluence content with provenance and tenant policy.

name: Microsoft SharePoint
description: Provides permission-trimmed document search, retrieval, citations, and page drafts.

name: Google Drive
description: Searches and retrieves Drive content using delegated permissions and classification labels.

name: Slack
description: Searches authorized conversations and creates outbound message drafts before approval.

name: Microsoft Teams
description: Searches permitted Teams content and creates approval-gated message drafts.

name: Enterprise Email
description: Searches governed mailboxes and creates draft-only outbound messages by default.

name: Federated Enterprise Search
description: Combines ACL-filtered providers with provenance, ranking, freshness, and classification metadata.

name: Jira
description: Reads, reviews, and approval-gates issue creation through typed operations.

name: ServiceNow
description: Searches records and proposes or executes approval-gated incidents and change requests.

name: Linear
description: Reads issues and creates scoped proposals with idempotency and audit evidence.

name: GitHub Enterprise
description: Reads repositories and proposes changes subject to branch protection and code ownership.

name: GitLab
description: Reads projects and proposes merge requests with protected-branch and approval controls.

name: Bitbucket
description: Reads repositories and proposes pull requests through workspace and branch policy.

name: CI and Change Evidence
description: Collects build, test, artifact, deployment, and change-management evidence.

name: Vulnerability Management
description: Normalizes Snyk, Wiz, Prisma, Defender, Tenable, Qualys, and internal findings.

name: SOC Operations
description: Queries SIEM data, proposes case actions, and approval-gates containment operations.

name: Software Supply Chain
description: Enforces SBOM, license, provenance, signing, dependency, and artifact admission controls.

name: Cloud and Kubernetes
description: Provides inventory reads and separates plan, approve, apply, and verify infrastructure operations.

name: Procurement and Vendor Risk
description: Collects vendor evidence and drafts governed risk reviews and procurement workflows.

name: Legal and Contract Review
description: Retrieves approved clauses and drafts reviews without granting autonomous legal authority.

name: Privacy Impact Assessment
description: Collects data-flow facts and drafts privacy assessments with reviewer checkpoints.

name: Records Retention
description: Projects retention, legal-hold, deletion, and residency policy into connector operations.

name: Finance and ERP
description: Provides strongly scoped finance reads and separation-of-duties approval for mutations.

name: Human Resources Information Systems
description: Provides privacy-sensitive HR workflows with field minimization and strict authorization.

name: Customer Support
description: Retrieves authorized cases and drafts responses with customer-data and send controls.
